subject: general
question:
Which of the following objects will sink in water? (Take the density of water as 1g/cm³ )

(i) An iron nail of density 2.5 g/cm³ 

(ii) A iron block of density 0.83 g/cm³ 

(iii) A iron ball of density 2 g/cm³
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both (i) and (iii)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Density and sinking in water:** An object sinks in water if its **density** is greater than the density of water, which is **1 g/cm³**.
 
• **Statement (i) - An iron nail of density 2.5 g/cm³:** The density of the iron nail is greater than the density of water. Hence, the iron nail will sink. ***This statement is correct.***
 
• **Statement (ii) - An iron block of density 0.83 g/cm³:** The density of the iron block is less than the density of water. Hence, the iron block will float. ***This statement is incorrect.***
 
• **Statement (iii) - An iron ball of density 2 g/cm³:** The density of the iron ball is greater than the density of water. Hence, the iron ball will sink. This statement is correct.</stro
